notes: Timeline = gapless mp3 decode (ffmpeg/libsndfile/browsers); the Demucs stems are separated from that decode. Tempo is taken as constant: 69.999 BPM (period 0.85715 s). The pulse of the drums is fitted over the whole song on drum+mix onset envelopes, then tempo and phase are refined by a line through the kick attack times (residual sd 8.7 ms). The song is in half time (kick on beats 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4 of a slow bar), so the grid keeps every second beat of that pulse: `beats` are the beats one taps along to, and the faster pulse is their halves. First beat 0.846 s. The grid is extrapolated through passages without drums. Bar phase (4/4): the beat position where the kick is loudest and the bass note / chord changes most often; first downbeat 1.703 s. Sections start on downbeats and follow the lyrics (analyze.py SECTIONS): a section that starts with a line starts on the downbeat of the bar in which that line starts, or on the next one when the line starts with a pickup shorter than 1.5 beats; an instrumental section (interlude, outro) starts on the first beat after the line before it. Envelopes: 100 fps, frame i centred at i/100 s, 46 ms RMS window, one-pole smoothing (10 ms attack / 90 ms release), each divided by its own 99th percentile and clipped to 0..1 (linear amplitude). low <150 Hz, mid 150-2000 Hz, high >4 kHz of the full mix; vocal/drums/bass/other = stem RMS. Onsets [time, strength 0-1] from the drums stem: kick = attack (steepest rise) of the <120 Hz band (378); snare = 1.5-5 kHz attacks whose 0.5-5 kHz noise tail 40-120 ms later is in the loudest local class (130); hat = >7 kHz attacks not within 40 ms of a snare or 30 ms of a kick (161). vocal = note onsets from the vocal stem (log-mel flux peaks + legato pitch jumps > 0.8 semitone), including backing vocals / ad-libs.
